metadata.question: Were the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels higher over Shanghai than over Wuhan during April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 (tropospheric nitrogen dioxide) - Date range: April 20 - May 12, 2020 - Locations: Shanghai (city center ~121.47°E, 31.23°N) and Wuhan (city center ~114.31°E, 30.59°N) - Need to compare mean NO2 levels at both locations during the same period 2. Masking strategy: - Sentinel-5P provides quality-assured NO2 data. Should apply quality flag filtering if available - May need to handle cloud/snow contamination flags 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid Zero (A/B): Both cities have valid NO2 measurements, compare means - C1: If collection is empty (no TROPOMI data in date range) - C2: If valid pixels = 0 (unlikely for TROPOMI but possible if AOI is outside coverage) - C3: If calculated mean is None/NaN or invalid range (NO2 should be 0-1000+ μmol/m²) - Compare: Shanghai_mean > Wuhan_mean → A, else → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometries for Shanghai and Wuhan const shanghai = ee.Geometry.Point([121.47, 31.23]); const wuhan = ee.Geometry.Point([114.31, 30.59]); // Buffer to ~30km to capture city-scale data const shanghaiBuffer = shanghai.buffer(30000); const wuhanBuffer = wuhan.buffer(30000); // 2. Define date range const startDate = '2020-04-20'; const endDate = '2020-05-12'; // 3. Load Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 collection const no2Collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_L3_NO2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const collectionSize = no2Collection.size().getInfo(); console.log('TROPOMI NO2 images in period: ' + collectionSize); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No TROPOMI data available for April 20 - May 12, 2020'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Calculate mean NO2 for Shanghai const no2BandShanghai = no2Collection.select('NO2_column_number_density'); const shanghaiMean = no2BandShanghai.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: shanghaiBuffer, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const shanghaiCount = no2BandShanghai.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: shanghaiBuffer, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); // 5. Calculate mean NO2 for Wuhan const no2BandWuhan = no2Collection.select('NO2_column_number_density'); const wuhanMean = no2BandWuhan.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: wuhanBuffer, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const wuhanCount = no2BandWuhan.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: wuhanBuffer, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); console.log('Shanghai: Mean=' + (shanghaiMean !== null ? shanghaiMean.toFixed(6) : 'null') + ' Pixels=' + shanghaiCount); console.log('Wuhan: Mean=' + (wuhanMean !== null ? wuhanMean.toFixed(6) : 'null') + ' Pixels=' + wuhanCount); // 6. Validation & comparison if (shanghaiMean === null || wuhanMean === null) { console.log('Null values detected in calculations'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (shanghaiCount === 0 || wuhanCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels found for one or both locations'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 7. Compare means if (shanghaiMean > wuhanMean) { console.log('Shanghai NO2 (' + shanghaiMean.toFixed(6) + ') > Wuhan NO2 (' + wuhanMean.toFixed(6) + ')'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Shanghai NO2 (' + shanghaiMean.toFixed(6) + ') <= Wuhan NO2 (' + wuhanMean.toFixed(6) + ')'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
